COMPLETE: omelettes, egg combos/benedicts/burritos, sizzlin' skillets, pancakes/waffles/french toast, salads, sandwiches, wraps, burgers, soup, a la carte sides, dessert, and drinks are all captured from the physical menu. One item (Reuben sandwich) had no legible price in any photo and was omitted rather than guessed.
